page.layout: Two columns of a Hebrew-Latin word list, left column then right column. Running head in Hebrew letters at top left and top right. Page number at top left. No notes in the margins, no catchword or signature.

main_text.p: תּוּבַל adducetur, תֻּבְלוּן deducenimi, תּוּבְלָה educentur, fut. Hoph. 3. f. f. 2. pl. m. parag. ut & 3. pl. f. Rad. יָבַל.
תּוֹנֵן merore afficietis, Job. 19.2. pro תּוֹנּוּ, fut. Hiph. 2. pl. m. parag. Rad. יָגָה.
תּוּגַת meror, f. fæm. constr. No. תּוּגַה; Rad. יָגָה maerore affecit.
תּוֹרָה celebratio, תּוֹרוֹת laudationes, No. f. & pl. fæm. Rad. יָרָה jecit.
תּוֹדִיעַ notum facies, תּוֹדִיעֵנִי mihi, fut. Hiph. 2. f. m. aff. Rad. יָדַע.
תּוֹרֵךְ celebrabit te, fut. Hiph. 3. f. f. תּוֹרָה, aff. Rad. יָדָה.
תּוֹדֵעַ notus fies, תּוֹדְעִי nota fies, fut. Niph. 2. f. m. & f. Rad. יָדַע.
תּוֹהֵל expectabis, fut. Hiph. 2. f. m. R. יָחַל.
ejus, No. sing. fem. תּוֹחַלְתָּהּ, aff. Rad. יָחַל.
תּוֹךְ medium, תּוֹכוֹ ejus, תּוֹכִי meum, תּוֹכְךָ tuum, תּוֹכָם eorum, No. f. m. constr. aff. No. Rad. תָּוֶךְ medium.
תּוֹךְ, vel תּוֹךְ delus vel medium, No. f. m. Rad. תָּכְךָ; vel constr. à No. Rad. תָּוֶךְ medium.
תּוֹכַח corripies, pro תּוֹבִיחַ, fut. Hiph. 2. f. m. Rad. יָכַח.
תּוֹכַחַת increpatio, תּוֹכַחְתִּי mea, תּוֹכָחוֹת increpationes, f. f. constr. aff. & pl. f. No. תּוֹכָחָה increpatio, Rad. יָכַח arguit.
תּוֹכִיחֵנִי reprehendes me, fut. Hiph. 2. f. m. aff. Rad. יָכַח.
תּוֹכִיחֲךָ corripient te, Jer. 2.19. pro תּוֹכִחֲנָה ךְ; fut. Hiph. 3. pl. masc. pro fæm. aff. Rad. יָכַח.

page.notes: Hebrew forms are copied from the scan at reduced resolution; the vowel points and several consonants are uncertain and should be checked against the original. "deducenimi" and "delus" are printed so; they may be printing errors for deducentini and dolus. The last line of the right column reads "ritis," and continues the hyphenated "pote-" from the line above.
